classification.difficultyReason: Convert masses to a common unit, multiply two quantities, add and express the total in two units.

content.prompt: A small bag of potatoes weighs 500 g and a large bag weighs 1.5 kg. What is the total weight if I buy 2 small and 3 large bags of potatoes? (Give your answer first in grams, and then in kilograms.)

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}1.5\text{ kg}&=1.5\times1000\text{ g}\\1.5\text{ kg}&=1500\text{ g}\\\text{Total weight}&=2\times500\text{ g}+3\times1500\text{ g}\\\text{Total weight}&=1000\text{ g}+4500\text{ g}\\\text{Total weight}&=5500\text{ g}\\\text{Total weight}&=(5500\div1000)\text{ kg}\\\text{Total weight}&=5.5\text{ kg}\end{align*}$$
